parsed.main_gap: The subset-sum gap bound (11) does not follow from the stated count, though including the empty and full subset sums repairs it directly.

errors.description: There are 2^{n+1}-3 internal consecutive gaps whose sum is less than 1, yielding only a gap below 1/(2^{n+1}-3), not d. Include all 2^{n+1} subset sums, including 0 and 1; their 2^{n+1}-1 gaps sum to 1, giving the required bound.
errors.quote:
their $2^{n+1}-3$ consecutive gaps sum to less than $1$. When put in nondecreasing order, two consecutive subset sums therefore differ by at most
\[
\frac1{2^{n+1}-1}=d.
\]

parsed.notes: Apart from this readily repairable counting error, the game-value reduction, pairing lemma, graph lower bound, cutting construction, and final calculation form a coherent and essentially complete proof.
